tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /'on khri smon du chos skyong la 'dod gsol bzhugs so// kye bstan dang de 'dzin skyong dang 'jig rten gyi/ /rgud skyobs legs spel spyi dang de rnams la/ /gnod byed log 'dren 'dul phyir dbang mchog rta/ /gtum drag skur bzhengs tse'u dmar 'khor bcas gson/ /nyes tshogs khri sel legs tshogs khri smon pa'i/ /dbang drag rol pa'i gnas 'dir 'go zhing 'ches/ /'khor 'das dregs byed ded dpon 'khor bcas rnams/ /gnas khang rten mchod mi nor kha rjer bcas/ /phyogs dus kun tu dar zhing rgyas pa dang / /pe har lha lcog sku g.yar 'di sogs la/ /log lta'i dgra bgegs myur sgrol 'dod don rnams/ /da lta mdzod cig srung ma mthu rtsal can/ /zhes 'di khri smon sger gzhis kyi/ /chos skyong chen po'i mgon khang du/ /dar tshon zhal byang can nyid du/ /sa skya pa yi brgyud 'dzin pa/ /ngag dbang kun blos de 'phral sbyar/ /sbyar ba bzhin du phrin las kun/ /kun nas myur ba'i rgyur gyur cig/ ༈ /spos dkar bla mas dgon de'i bla ma bzang po'i mchog sprul myur 'byon 'dod gsol du zhus gnang dge/ swasti/ blo chen dpal stsol yang dag rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /bzang po kun 'byung lung rtogs dam pa'i chos/ /bstan pa 'dzin mdzad 'phags mchog 'dus tshogs kyi/ /dge legs yar 'phel mchog sprul myur ston gsol/ /ces 'di sa rgan kun blo la/ /'phags yul spos dkar ri khrod pa'i/ /dgon de'i bla ma bzang po yi/ /mchog sprul phebs bskul don du smras// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 4 kun dga' blo gros/ 'on khri smon du chos skyong la 'dod gsol/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
